# Tutorial 2 · Fetch

This is the machine the [Fetch](exuarch:guide/fetch-routine) tutorial starts from, built step by step as the tutorials before it say, ending with [Ground zero](exuarch:guide/ground-zero). Load it if you skipped a tutorial or lost your own machine, and carry on from there.

It is an example like the others: change it as much as you like, and **Reset** brings it back the way it starts. To keep your work separately, make a copy with **New…**, *Copy of the current machine*.
